title: Inventory
note: Not accounting inventory — a record to see how much is left.
returnHint: When leftover materials come back from a site. Take a photo, pick the item and quantity — stock goes up.
noItems: No items yet (register them in the admin inventory page)
notePlaceholder: e.g. left at the loading bay
saveFailed: Could not save. Check your connection and try again
aiNote: AI is only an aid. Candidates can be wrong — always check
aiFound: Candidates found (AI read: {name}). Tap if correct, otherwise search below
aiNotInMaster: AI read "{name}" but it is not registered yet. You can register it below
aiUnreadable: Could not read the item from the photo. Search below or register it
aiNotConfigured: AI identification is not available in this environment. Search below
noMatch: No matching item. Set category to All or register a new one
newExisted: "{name}" already existed, so it was selected
outHint: When taking leftovers from the warehouse to the next site. Stock goes down.
inHint: Only when a delivery goes straight to the warehouse. Stock goes up.
disabled: This feature is not enabled for this account (an admin can turn it on in Settings › Features).
officeModeNote: At this company the office confirms the item: send the photo and quantity (pick the item if you know it). Stock updates after confirmation.
savedPending: Sent. Stock will update once the office confirms the item
